body:
GARBY now has refined category dividers, clearer status indicators, immersive fullscreen and a corrected launcher icon. The visible app version and this release title are **Most Latest**.

- Android status/navigation bars stay hidden across screens and confirmation dialogs, including after Home/resume. Edge swipes temporarily reveal system controls.
- Launcher foreground uses the official GARBY wordmark/cart as a centered vector; round, rounded-square and themed masks retain the mark without the tiny print tagline.
- Return-state calculations and server-response handling use the existing bounded background dispatcher. Readiness checks, database paths and robot commands are unchanged.
- Category icons, live summaries, stale/unavailable symbols and font-aware metric layouts remain included.

The exact optimized APK was installed and checked on the authorized test phone with app data retained. In the same six-swipe sequence, janky frames changed from **57.1% to 20.0%**, P90 frame time from **81 to 36 ms**, and process memory from **153.3 to 61.1 MiB**. The original installation was a debug/test-only build. The comparison includes moving to optimized compilation and the source changes; some jank remains and only one phone was measured.

Verified with **53 passing unit tests**, lint with no issues, static checks, native icon/mask previews, debug/release/optimized builds, and APK signature/hash checks. Fullscreen, transient bars, confirmation cancellation, Home/resume and blocked return-screen navigation passed. No robot return command was sent.

Downloads:

- `garby-most-latest.apk`: the exact installed, non-debuggable, R8-minified APK, signed with the existing local development certificate.
- `garby-most-latest-release-unsigned.apk`: production release output for external signing.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: SHA-256 hashes for both APKs.

For performance checks in Android Studio, select the `benchmark` variant. Run with `debug` replaces the optimized installation with an instrumented debug build.

[Changed files, screenshots and runtime verification](https://github.com/YAKITORIHOSHI/Garby-Mobile-App/blob/most-latest/docs/2026-11-14-fullscreen.md).

No signing key is published. **MCU upload requirement: None. Pi deployment requirement: None.**
name: Most Latest
